rows.Origin:
Bred by William A. Warriner (United States, before 1976).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (post 1970) in 1976 as 'Fulgurante'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red, purple shading. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
